title: CLIMATE DATA ANALYSIS
description: Quantitative methods to characterize the physical climate system and detect change. Interpret data based on source timescale, and statistics; communicate conclusions and uncertainties regarding past climate and future changes.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (ATS 201 or CLIM 201) and ST 351.
A minimum grade of C- is required in ATS 201, CLIM 201 and ST 351.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:50am in STAG 361 - Strand Agriculture Hall 361 (9/23 to 12/4)
